title: Build construction project tracking application with RAP/RAB, multi-stage approval workflow, and accounting system

requirements.text: Implement user authentication system with Internet Identity supporting four roles: Admin, Foreman (Mandor), Buyer, and Finance with role-based access control

quotes: Saya ingin ada role user dan permissionnya
4 Role: Admin, Mandor, Buyer, Keuangan

acceptanceCriteria: Users can authenticate using Internet Identity
System enforces four distinct roles: Admin, Foreman, Buyer, Finance
Each role has appropriate permissions for their workflow stage
Users can only access features permitted for their role

requirements.text: Create master data management system for Materials (name, unit, price), Jobs/Pekerjaan, and Vendors/Suppliers with CRUD operations

quotes: Master Material (nama, satuan, harga)
Master Pekerjaan
Master Vendor/Supplier

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create, read, update, and delete materials with name, unit, and price fields
Admin can manage jobs/work items master data
Admin can manage vendor/supplier master data
All master data is accessible for use in RAP creation

requirements.text: Implement RAP (Rencana Anggaran Pelaksanaan) and RAB (Rencana Anggaran Biaya) creation system with unlimited nested sub-job structure where each level has its own volume, unit, and separate cost

quotes: Aplikasi bisa membuat RAP dan RAB
Dimana user bisa membuat RAp dari master2 ,.sehingga user tinggal tempel
Unlimited levels (user bisa buat nested sub-pekerjaan sesuka hati)
Setiap sub-pekerjaan punya volume, satuan, dan biaya sendiri

acceptanceCriteria: Users can create RAP/RAB by selecting from master data (materials, jobs)
Sub-jobs can be nested to unlimited depth levels
Each job and sub-job level has independent volume, unit, and cost fields
Cost at each level is manually entered and not auto-calculated from children
Users can build RAP structure hierarchically with main jobs and nested sub-jobs

requirements.text: Create master RAP template system that allows users to save reusable RAP structures and apply existing templates to new projects

quotes: User bisa membuat template sendiri, atau template yg sudah ada
Master template RAP yang bisa dipakai ulang untuk proyek-proyek baru

acceptanceCriteria: Users can save a RAP structure as a master template
Templates preserve the complete nested sub-job hierarchy
Users can browse and select from existing master templates
Applying a template creates a new RAP instance that can be customized
Templates are reusable across multiple projects

requirements.text: Implement material/fund request workflow where Foreman selects a main job (automatically including all sub-jobs and materials) to create a request

quotes: role mandor atau orang lapangan akan meminta dana / material dari tiap pekerjaan berdasarkan RAp yg ada
Mandor pilih pekerjaan utama → otomatis include semua sub-pekerjaan dan material di dalamnya

acceptanceCriteria: Foreman can create material/fund requests based on RAP jobs
Selecting a main job automatically includes all nested sub-jobs and their materials
Request captures the complete job hierarchy with quantities and costs
Request is submitted to Buyer for review

requirements.text: Implement Buyer review and approval stage where Buyer can view requests from Foreman, edit quantities and prices, and approve partially with remaining amounts tracked for future requests

quotes: Laporan diterima bagian buyer, buyer bisa edit qty ,harga dan acc sebagian. Dimana nanti.mandor bisa minta lagi sisanya
Buyer: Review, edit qty/harga, approve sebagian → mandor bisa request sisa

acceptanceCriteria: Buyer receives requests from Foreman in their dashboard
Buyer can edit quantity and price for requested items
Buyer can approve requests partially (approve a portion of the requested amount)
System tracks remaining unapproved amounts
Foreman can submit new requests for the remaining amounts
Approved requests move to Finance stage

requirements.text: Implement Finance review and approval stage where Finance receives data from Buyer, can edit and approve partially, with final approval completing the workflow

quotes: Lalu data dari buyer akan di terima keuangan. Sama keuangan jg bisa edit dan acc sebagian dari data buyer
Keuangan: Review data dari buyer, edit & approve sebagian

acceptanceCriteria: Finance receives approved requests from Buyer
Finance can edit request details
Finance can approve requests partially
System tracks Finance approval status and remaining amounts
Final Finance approval completes the request workflow
Completed approvals trigger next stage (realization reporting)

requirements.text: Implement realization report system where Buyer inputs actual prices from invoices/receipts after Finance approval is complete

quotes: Ada menu laporan realisasi untuk buyer, dimana buyer akan melaporkan sesuai bon atau harga asli
Buyer input harga aktual sesuai bon/invoice dari vendor
Tahap lanjutan setelah approval keuangan selesai

acceptanceCriteria: Buyer can access realization report form after Finance approval completes
Buyer inputs actual prices based on vendor invoices/receipts
System records realization data linked to the original request
Realization data is available for accounting system consumption

requirements.text: Implement comprehensive accounting system with automatic journal entries, general ledger, balance sheet, profit and loss statement, cash flow report, and budget vs actual comparison per job

quotes: Akan lebih baik jika ada pengelolaan accountingnya juga
Jurnal transaksi otomatis, Buku besar, Neraca, Laporan laba rugi, Cash flow proyek, Budget vs actual per pekerjaan

acceptanceCriteria: System automatically generates journal entries from realization reports
General ledger aggregates all journal entries by account
Balance sheet displays assets, liabilities, and equity
Profit and loss statement shows revenue and expenses
Cash flow report tracks project cash movements
Budget vs actual report compares planned (RAP) vs actual (realization) costs per job
Accounting data sources from Buyer realization reports

requirements.text: Implement progress tracking system where progress dates are recorded for main jobs to generate S-Curve data

quotes: mandor ada laporan untuk progress pekerjaan
Kurva S berdasarkan pekerjaan utama (level teratas)
Kurva S: Pencatatan tanggal progress pekerjaan (timeline)

acceptanceCriteria: System records progress dates for main jobs (top-level jobs)
Progress tracking captures timeline milestones
Progress data is separate from material usage and cost realization
Progress dates are used as input for S-Curve generation

requirements.text: Implement S-Curve visualization showing timeline progress versus planned schedule based on main jobs with interactive chart

quotes: Saya ingin agar bisa bentuk kurva S
Kurva S - Visualisasi progress vs rencana dengan grafik interaktif
Kurva S: Visualisasi progress timeline vs rencana (berdasarkan pekerjaan utama)

acceptanceCriteria: S-Curve displays graphically as a cumulative progress curve over time
Chart shows planned schedule curve and actual progress curve
S-Curve is based on main job progress data (not sub-jobs)
Chart is interactive and updates in real-time as progress is recorded
Visual clearly distinguishes between plan and actual progress

requirements.text: Create role-specific dashboards for Admin, Foreman, Buyer, and Finance showing relevant overview, summaries, and pending items for each role

quotes: Dashboard per role
Overview khusus per role
Summary proyek, permintaan pending, progress

acceptanceCriteria: Each role has a dedicated dashboard view upon login
Admin dashboard shows system overview and project summaries
Foreman dashboard shows request status, remaining amounts, and progress input options
Buyer dashboard shows pending requests for review, realization report forms, and material usage visibility
Finance dashboard shows pending approvals, accounting summaries, and financial reports
Dashboards display real-time data relevant to each role's workflow

requirements.text: Implement material usage tracking where Buyer can view total materials used against requests when additional requests are submitted

quotes: dmn input material yg terpakai hingga buyer bisa lihat sudah brp material yg terpakai ketika ada permintaan tambahan

acceptanceCriteria: System tracks cumulative material usage per job
Buyer can view material usage reports showing total materials consumed
Material usage is visible when Foreman submits additional requests
Report helps Buyer assess necessity of additional material requests

requirements.text: Design and implement a creative, cohesive visual theme with distinct style (colors, typography, layout) suitable for a professional construction project management application, avoiding blue and purple color schemes
acceptanceCriteria: Application has a consistent color palette throughout (avoiding blue and purple)
Typography is clear and professional for construction/engineering context
Layout supports complex data tables and hierarchical structures
Visual style conveys reliability and professionalism
Design patterns are applied consistently across all pages and components

constraints: Backend must use single-actor Motoko architecture with all logic in main.mo
Frontend must use React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and React Query
Authentication must use Internet Identity (no external auth providers)
Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
No external databases - use Internet Computer's stable storage
S-Curve visualization must use supported charting libraries compatible with React
nonGoals: Third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity
Export to Excel/PDF (can be added later if needed)
Multi-project portfolio management in initial version
Advanced financial features like payroll or invoicing beyond accounting reports
